thread:
Riley: Heads up  quick creative ask for the webinar + benchmark narrative. Need: 1x benchmark deck cover (1920x1080), 1x social reel cover (1080x1920), 2x LinkedIn hero variants, and a compact benchmark infographic (800x1000) for the blog. Deliver by Thu EOD. Also require brand compliance sign-off.

Tara: Can we scope copy? Prefer short headlines + a 20-30 word subhead. Also request a social card template that growth can edit for paid copy overlays.

Evan: I'll provide the 25-word subhead and a short product blurb. Also sending final latency/cost numbers.

Priya: Design constraints  follow editorial tone, avoid heavy shadows, use accent token only for CTAs. Provide outline for alt text.

Riley: Ask growth: keep two creative hooks: "Beef up" technical audience with p95 metric, and "Outcome" audience with cost savings.

DesignBot: New task CR-2461 created and assigned to Tara. Due: 48 hours.

Tara: I'll produce two direction comps tonight and tag brand for quick review. Proposed filenames include: redwood_bench_cover_v1.jpg, redwood_social_reel_cover_v1.png, redwood_linkedin_hero_a_v1.png.

Priya: Small accessibility note: ensure headline 28px+ on mobile and that color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text.

Evan: Uploading numbers now to the shared doc. Also adding a short quote from the lead engineer.

Riley: Thanks team. If we get brand approval, growth will schedule the paid flight for next week.

DesignBot: CR-2461 status: In design (Tara). ETA updated: 30h.

Tara: Pinging for brand check when I post comps.

Riley: Will review and flag any issues promptly.
